title: Executive dashboard endpoint responds 200 for an authenticated vciso.read user
steps: Call GET /organizations/:orgId/executive-dashboard with a valid JWT holding vciso.read
expectedResult: 200 response with { success: true, data: {...} } and no server error.

title: /vciso root route redirects to /vciso/executive-dashboard without error
steps: Navigate to /vciso as an authenticated user with vciso.read
expectedResult: Client-side redirect to /vciso/executive-dashboard completes before first paint; no console error, no blank page.

title: Roadmap endpoint returns 200 with the base roadmap shape
steps: Call GET /strategic-planning/roadmap with a valid JWT holding vciso.read
expectedResult: 200 response with success:true and a data object containing quarters/goals/initiatives arrays (or exists:false with a message if no roadmap has been configured yet).

title: FAIR scenarios list endpoint returns 200 for a new org with zero scenarios
steps: Call GET /risk-intelligence/scenarios for a brand-new org
expectedResult: 200 response with data.items = [] and total = 0 — no server error on an empty scenario collection.

title: Report templates endpoint returns 200 and includes the system-provided templates
steps: Call GET /board-reporting/templates with a valid JWT holding vciso.read
expectedResult: 200 response with a non-empty data array containing at least the built-in system templates, even for an org that has never created a custom template.
